author: TeIq
content: Delivered: MemoryAnomalyDetector with rolling-window Welford's-algorithm stats per (category, severity). Welford online update + online removal for eviction. Configurable bucket_duration + history_size + threshold_z_score. AnomalyObservation carries current_count + expected_mean + expected_stddev + z_score (f32). Per-closed-bucket dedup. seed_bucket public method for cold-start from DB. Out-of-order events drop silently. 11 tests including 100k Welford stability + 1 proptest false-positive bound on stationary uniform. polaris-backend/src/pattern/{mod,anomaly}.rs.
